subject: Renewal kickoff: burst commit + onramp & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <al.monroe@starlit.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Perez <s.perez@starlit.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: burst needs + QBR availability

Irene — thanks for taking this. We're getting close to our renewal window and want to lock in: a) an annual commit that covers our baseline + a short burst lane for Black Friday-style spikes, and b) a one-hour QBR to align stakeholders and review SLOs.

Key asks from our side:
- Commit term: 12 months with a predictable burst pool we can trigger for up to 8 hours at a time.
- Latency: maintain p95 <= 220ms for standard gen during burst (we'll share sample traffic).
- Legal/procurement: I'll loop in procurement for contract redlines (sending separately).

Availability for QBR: next week looks tight for execs. Best windows (PST): Tue 10/6 10–11am, Wed 10/7 1–2pm, or Fri 10/9 9–10am. If none work we'll do a 45-minute slot and follow up with a readout.

I'll attach the initial redlines we have from legal so you can route to your contracts team.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—Alex
Alex Monroe
Head of Platform, Starlit AI
al.monroe@starlit.ai
+1 415-555-0124
Attachment: starlit-redlines-v1.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <al.monroe@starlit.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: burst needs + QBR availability

Alex — great context, and thanks for the redlines. Looping in Ben (Account Lead) and Karthik (Solutions / SRE lead) so we can coordinate pricing/throughput and the burst safety plan.

Quick proposed plan:
1) QBR — lock Tue 10/6 10–11am PST. We'll send an invite with an agenda (commit overview, burst policy, SLOs + runbook walkthrough, legal/next steps).
2) Technical prep — Karthik, can you validate whether the requested p95 <= 220ms is achievable in our current config for the 8hr burst profile? If not, propose SLO alternatives and mitigations.
3) Commercial — Ben, I'll need a pricing sketch for a 12mo commit with an attached monthly burst allowance and per-minute overage. Please include a 30-day ramp credit to cover the onramp period.
4) Contracts — Procurement (Starlit), we saw your redlines. We'll review and come back with an annotated DocuSign link.

I've attached our onboarding runbook draft showing how we handle burst activation and emergency fallbacks — this should help frame the QBR technical discussion.

Next steps for today: Ben/Karthik, can you confirm by EOD whether Tue 10/6 works and if you need any test traffic samples ahead of the meeting? Alex/Procurement, if you prefer Wed or Fri, tell us now and we'll pivot.

Thanks —

Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-onramp-runbook-v2.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Sam Perez <s.perez@starlit.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Alex Monroe <al.monroe@starlit.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@starlit.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: burst needs + QBR availability

Thanks — Tue 10/6 10am PST works for our execs. I've added our procurement lead (procure@starlit.ai) and legal contact (legal@starlit.ai) to the thread.

A couple quick notes:
- Procurement will send formal redlines via DocuSign today (expect the link).
- We rely on a pair of downstream services with hard SLAs — if you can share the burst activation steps in the runbook at least 24 hours ahead of the QBR, our infra team will run a smoke test.


—Sam
Sam Perez
Director, Platform Engineering, Starlit AI
s.perez@starlit.ai
Attachment: (none)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Starlit renewal kickoff — action list before 10/6 QBR

Ben / Karthik — quick internal checklist before the 10/6 10am PST QBR with Starlit: 

Action items
- Ben: prepare a commercial sketch — 12mo commit + monthly burst pool (items: base qps, burst cap, per-minute overage rate, 30-day ramp credit). Slide 1 of QBR should contain the proposed commit and a small table of unit economics.
- Karthik: validate p95 target for the stated burst profile. If current infra can't meet 220ms, provide two fallback options (config + quantization profile) and estimated perf delta. Also prepare a 5-min runbook walkthrough focusing on burst activation, KV cache warming, and fallback model variants.
- Irene: coordinate invite, draft agenda, and upload the runbook to the shared folder. I'll also pull relevant latency dashboards and token-cost breakdown to show at the QBR.
- Ops/SRE contact to loop in if Karthik needs a point-of-contact for a pre-QBR smoke test.

I'll seed the calendar invite now and attach the runbook we sent. If either of you see a blocker, reply-all and flag — otherwise we proceed to the 10/6 slot.

Thanks —
Irene
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
